data.action: 侧倚在松软的纯白大床被褥间，金色短发凌乱铺散，赤瞳倒映着柔和光晕，单手轻伸向身前，红润唇瓣微启露出毫无防备的温柔
data.description: 铺着蓬松羽绒的纯白大床上，爱尔奎特舒适地侧身斜倚在枕被间。金色短发散落，白皙细腻的肌肤在夜色中如羊脂玉般温润。她一只手枕在脸侧，另一只手在床单上轻轻伸向前方，赤红剔透的眼眸闪烁着水润光泽，带着对爱人全然信任的娇俏浅笑。
data.lighting: 窗外如银水般的月光与床头昏暗暖烛
data.location: 主卧纯白床榻中央散落的羽绒枕间
data.nsfwProse: Unclothed beneath the loosely draped white duvet, her bare shoulders, collarbone, and smooth back gleam softly in the blended candle and moon light.
data.promptProse: On a wide white bed bathed in window moonlight and a bedside candle, Arcueid reclines comfortably on her side among soft pillows. She props her head on one arm and extends her other hand gently across the crumpled white sheets toward the viewer.
data.title: 爱尔奎特 · 纯白床榻的深情仰卧交付
data.animaCaption: Lying nude on her side across the fluffy white bedding with the duvet draped low across her waist, she rests her head on the pillow and reaches one hand forward with a soft blush and gentle smile.
